title: Signer-egress stubs must match the observed callsite
invariant: A local signer-egress stub is reusable only when it wraps the observed transport callsite and fires the same continuation callbacks the next-page signer reads; wrapping a quieter sibling channel, omitting the continuation, or harvesting a returned export instead of the observed egress leaves the follow-up unsigned.

appliesWhen: a local helper must harvest a signer field from an in-page transport call
the page exposes more than one transport-looking channel such as XHR, fetch, or library ajax
the next request is issued from a success, complete, or load continuation
the page also exposes a returned export that looks like a signer
stopsWhen: the signer is a returned export rather than an egress harvest
wrapping the observed callsite plus its continuation already yields the follow-up field
the missing field follows clock, key, or session mutation rather than the stub

oracles.positive: python scripts/experience_fixture_check.py references/experience-fixtures/signer-egress-stub-matrix.json reports positiveOracle=true, callsiteMatched=true, continuationRequired=true, and returnedExportRejected=true
oracles.negative: setting xhr-send-only.oracle=true, ajax-success-without-complete.secondPageHarvested=true, or returned-export-instead-of-ajax-harvest.oracle=true must fail the fixture checker

decision.action: wrap the observed transport callsite and fire the continuation the next-page signer reads
decision.fallback: if the right callsite plus continuation still misses, stop blaming the stub and open preimage or session
